newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers steady in thin talks.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers steady in thin talks.

text.p: Singapore bunker prices held steady on Tuesday amid continued strength in crude values but shipowners were sidelines when offers were high, traders said.
There were only few enquiries and sentiment was cautious, they said. "I am still holding prices," said one trader. "With strong crude and cargo, bunker should not go down."
Bunker 180-cst was quoted at $100-103 per tonne and 380-cst was at $95-98. MDO and gas oil were at $198-$203 and $210-$215 respectively.
